liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Promised Land**: rare: 8 archived performances [18]
- **Not Fade Away Chant**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Don't Ease Me In [18]

## The recordings

- **dead2015-11-17** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 185 min; rated 4.69/5 by 13 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the recording excellent; Reviewer finds this recording far better than their own, which sounds modest beside it; Reviewer says the recording sounds very good [10][11][12]
- **dac2015-11-17.ccm41v.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 186 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **DeadCo2015.11.17.audmtx**: source not stated; 19 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **dc2015-11-17.xyh5.aud.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: The taper's own section was crowded, loud and talkative, and the crowd noise shows up on the recording [4]

## Around the show

- Atlanta is where Mayer started professionally, so reviewer felt he had more to prove to the home crowd [14]
- Z-Man recorded from the official tapers' section on the floor, with mics 8.5 feet high [1]
- The band teased Norwegian Wood about 13:30 into the track [2]
- The balcony effectively became general admission that night; people in the nearby section were relaxed and friendly [4]
- Reviewer says some songs got sloppy, but the band was in good shape for only its tenth show [7]
- Reviewer calls it another strong show, with Weir and the Rhythm Devils sounding rejuvenated [10]
- Reviewer found Atlanta weaker than other shows heard, and expected better after the Saturday Greensboro, NC show [11]
- Reviewer considers this the best show of the tour so far [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **dead2015-11-17**: taped by zmanatl; source: Schoeps CCM4V's>Lunatec V2>Benchmark AD2K>Sound Devices 722 (24/44) [1]. Also: Reviewer also taped this show, from outside the official tapers' section; Processed from the 722 through Sound Forge 10 and CD Wave to 16-bit FLAC, tagged in Foobar 2000 [1][11]
- **dac2015-11-17.ccm41v.flac16**: taped by c. cage; transferred by c. cage; source: schoeps ccm41V's>femto audioroot pre >ocm r44 24/48 [2]. Also: Schoeps CCM41V mics into a Femto Audio preamp and OCM R44 recorder at 24/48, from the tapers' section; Transferred from SDHC card, dithered in Audacity, split in CD Wave, and encoded to FLAC level 8 [2]
- **DeadCo2015.11.17.audmtx**: Source 1 is Z-Man's Schoeps CCM4V, Lunatec V2, Benchmark AD2K and Sound Devices 722 recording at 24/44 [3]
- **dc2015-11-17.xyh5.aud.flac2496**: taped by Grahamps; transferred by Grahamps; source: AUD [4]. Also: Recorded with a Zoom H5 on a tabletop tripod, mounted on the video screen wall frame in section 308 [4]
